o: "Write a friendly 3 line email to a customer whose order is late. Offer 10% off."
quizzes.why: Details in, quality out. Tell it who, what and how.
It can read images, including handwriting. Double check names and numbers.

quizzes.q: What should you {always} do before sending an AI reply?
quizzes.why: AI drafts. You decide. Read every word before it goes out.

quizzes.q: Is the {free} version of Claude enough to start?
quizzes.why: Free is plenty to learn and do real work. Upgrade only when you hit limits.

o: A chatbot answers. An agent does a task.
quizzes.why: Agents take action, like drafting every reply in your inbox.

quizzes.q: Best way to make AI sound like {you?}
o: Paste examples of how you write
quizzes.why: Show, don't tell. Two real examples beat any description.

quizzes.q: AI stated a fact that's {wrong.} What happened?
quizzes.why: AI can sound sure and still be wrong. Always check facts that matter.

quizzes.q: How long does a Business Brain take to {make?}
quizzes.why: 15 questions, about 5 minutes. Comment BRAIN on any post for the free tool.

polls.q: Would you let AI {draft} your replies?
Do you reply to new leads within {1 hour?}

facts.f: Claude can explain any {bill} from a photo.
facts.more: Snap the medical bill, phone bill or bank statement. It explains every line in plain English and flags charges that look off.
facts.try: "Explain this bill line by line. Anything I should question?"

facts.f: Claude can write the {cancel} message for you.
facts.more: Tell it the company and what you want. You get a short, firm message that's hard to argue with.
facts.try: "Write a firm message to cancel my gym membership today."

facts.f: Claude can write your {dispute} letter.
facts.more: Give it the date, the amount and what went wrong. It writes a clear, polite letter that gets read.
facts.try: "Write a dispute for a $45 late fee. I paid on time."

facts.p: A lease or contract to sign
facts.f: Claude can find the {catch} in a contract.
facts.more: Upload it before you sign. Ask what could cost you money or lock you in.
facts.try: "List anything in here that could cost me money."

facts.p: Dinner with nothing in the fridge
facts.f: Claude can plan dinner from a {fridge} photo.
facts.more: Take a picture of what you have. It gives you meals you can make tonight without a store run.
facts.try: "What can I cook in 30 minutes with this?"

facts.f: Claude can turn a week of meals into one {list.}
facts.more: Tell it your budget and how many people. It plans the meals and sorts the list by store aisle.
facts.try: "Plan 5 cheap dinners for 4 people and make the grocery list."

facts.f: Claude can write the {hard} email for you.
facts.more: Asking for a raise, saying no, chasing money you're owed. Tell it the situation and the tone.
facts.try: "Help me ask my boss for a raise. Confident, not pushy."

facts.f: Claude can explain {homework} like you're 10.
facts.more: Snap the problem. Ask it to teach the steps, not just give the answer, so you can help.
facts.try: "Explain how to solve this step by step for a 10 year old."

facts.p: A letter from the IRS or the city
facts.f: Claude can explain {official} letters.
facts.more: Upload the letter. It tells you what it means, the deadline and what to do next.
facts.try: "What is this letter asking me to do, and by when?"

facts.p: A doctor's note full of jargon
facts.f: Claude can explain your {lab results.}
facts.more: Paste them in. Use it to prepare questions, then ask your doctor.
facts.try: "Explain this in plain English. What should I ask my doctor?"

facts.f: Claude can sort your {spending} for you.
facts.more: Paste a month of transactions. It groups them and shows where the money actually went.
facts.try: "Group these by category and show my top 3 money leaks."

facts.f: Claude can build a full {trip} in minutes.
facts.more: Give it the city, the days and your budget. You get a day by day plan you can edit.
facts.try: "Plan 3 days in Miami for 2 people, $800 total."

facts.f: Claude can tailor your {resume} to the job.
facts.more: Paste your resume and the job post. It rewrites your bullets to match what they're asking for.
facts.try: "Rewrite my resume bullets to fit this job post."

facts.p: A text you don't know how to answer
facts.f: Claude can help you {reply} without the drama.
facts.more: Paste the message and say what you want to happen. It gives you a calm reply.
facts.try: "Help me reply to this. Calm, short, and I want to say no."

facts.f: Claude can {translate} a photo.
facts.more: Menus, signs, labels, instructions. Snap it and ask what it says.
facts.try: "What does this say, and is there anything I should know?"

facts.f: Claude can help you {fix} it from a photo.
facts.more: Leaky faucet, tripped breaker, error code on the washer. Show it and ask for the steps.
facts.try: "What's wrong here and how do I fix it myself safely?"

facts.p: A review you need to answer
facts.f: Claude can reply to a bad {review} for you.
facts.more: Paste the review. It writes a reply that sounds human, owns the problem and fixes it.
facts.try: "Write a calm, short reply to this 1 star review."

facts.f: Claude can {compare} anything side by side.
facts.more: Two phones, two quotes, two insurance plans. Paste both and ask for a simple table.
facts.try: "Compare these two quotes in a table. Which is better value?"

facts.p: A 40 page report you won't read
facts.f: Claude can {summarize} a long document in seconds.
facts.more: Paste the report, the transcript or the PDF. Ask for the points that matter.
facts.try: "Give me the 5 points that matter, in plain English."

facts.p: Writing a toast or a speech
facts.f: Claude can write a {speech} that sounds like you.
facts.more: Give it names, two stories and how long you have. Then ask it to make it sound more like you.
facts.try: "Write a 1 minute toast for my brother's wedding. Funny, not cheesy."
